Ukraine's air force is expected to be sent to the region by January. The new US warships will assist in the fighting, though they will not be equipped with modern weapons. The US defence secretary, Ashton Carter, told reporters on Monday that the ships would be deployed in the region. However, he also said that it was unlikely that the US ships would be deployed on the peninsula, though he said it was expected that some ships would be deployed there soon.
